stories.title: 2-month-old girl found lying in ditch with mother after hit-and-run dies, sheriff says
stories.summary: Investigators say the mother was walking with her baby daughter in a stroller when a car hit them from behind.

stories.title: First Alert Forecast: Drier conditions, lighter winds ahead of a Thanksgiving cold front
stories.summary: The fast-moving front is expected to bring rain and gusty northerly winds Wednesday night and early Thanksgiving Day morning.

stories.title: ‘Totally illegal’: Trump administration auctions deep-sea mining leases amid legal challenges
stories.summary: The leases cover 31 million acres of seabed off American Samoa, and were sold to mining company Wetstone U.S. Ventures for $6 million.

stories.title: Motorists warned of possible lane closure on Kamehameha Highway
stories.summary: Officials said the Kaneohe-bound lane could be closed while crews complete the work.

stories.title: 1-month-old killed in dog attack at a home, investigators say
stories.summary: Authorities are investigating after a dog attack at a home left a 1-month-old baby dead.

stories.title: Hawaii State Archives highlights artifacts ahead of Hawaiian Independence Day
stories.summary: The holiday commemorates the day in 1843 when the Kingdom of Hawaii was officially recognized as a sovereign nation.

stories.title: Lost and found: How old photo albums tossed out in Waikiki were reunited with relatives in Chicago
stories.summary: The woman who found the albums was determined to find the family of the man who took the photos. It took weeks.

stories.title: Rainbow Wahine in Las Vegas ahead of Mountain West tournament debut
stories.summary: The Rainbow Wahine are the No. 1 seed in the four-team playoff tournament.

stories.title: Over 3,000 runners raise money for Hawaii canoe and environmental groups
stories.summary: Runners and walkers were up early Sunday morning to raise money for local canoe and environmental groups and catch a beautiful view.

stories.title: Helemano Farms opens for holiday season
stories.summary: Helemano Farms, a longtime Central Oahu Christmas tree farm, is open for the holiday season on Saturday.

stories.title: Man accused of biting deportation officer during detainment, affidavit says
stories.summary: A man allegedly bit an Enforcement and Removal Operations officer while being detained, according to an affidavit.

stories.title: HECO utility work to impact traffic in downtown Honolulu Monday
